name: cityverse
description: CITYVERSE - 3D City Builder, Life Simulation & Multiplayer

scripts.dev: concurrently -n SHARED,SERVER,CLIENT -c yellow,cyan,green "npm run dev -w @cityverse/shared" "npm run dev -w @cityverse/server" "npm run dev -w @cityverse/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @cityverse/shared && npm run build -w @cityverse/server && npm run build -w @cityverse/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @cityverse/shared && npm run typecheck -w @cityverse/server && npm run typecheck -w @cityverse/client
scripts.test: npm run test -w @cityverse/server && npm run test -w @cityverse/client
